scientificAccuracy.notes: Science certified for assessment_earths-layers__r2 (ruling R2-D1 approves the canonical r2 questions): differentiation by density, layer order, the brittle least-dense crust, denser oceanic crust sinking beneath continental crust, the solid but slowly flowing mantle, the rigid plate-forming lithosphere over the slowly flowing asthenosphere, convection from density differences, the inner core kept solid by pressure, earthquakes from released energy, and the heat to convection to plate motion to surface-change chain.
